description: This is a Java class that provides configuration properties for cryptographic signature operations, including secret keys, key file paths, token expiration, and certificate paths.

classes.name: SignatureSupportingConfigProperties
classes.description: A class that encapsulates cryptographic signature configuration properties such as shared secret, key and certificate paths, and token expiration settings.

methods.name: getSharedSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the shared secret used for HmacSHA256 signatures.

methods.name: setSharedSecret
methods.description: Sets the shared secret, requiring it to be at least 32 bytes.

methods.name: setKeyPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the private key used for SHA256withRSA signatures.

methods.name: getKeyPath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path to the private key.

methods.name: getTokenExpiration
methods.description: Gets the token expiration period in seconds.

methods.name: setTokenExpiration
methods.description: Sets the token expiration period in seconds, requiring a positive value.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the X.509 certificate for signature validation.

methods.name: getCertPath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path to the certificate.

methods.name: isAppropriateForCreating
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has enough information to create cryptographic assertions.

methods.name: isAppropriateForValidating
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has enough information to validate cryptographic assertions.
